messages:
Rae Torres: Pushing a small docs PR to update Nimbus-7B and Zephyr-6.8B model cards. Changes: max_input_tokens -> 8192, add quantized compatibility notes, small Go + curl snippets, and a benchmark footnote about fixed batch sizes. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4890
Ben Morales: Nice. Do we have validated perf for 8k on both models? Need explicit sequences used for latency/throughput rows.
Rae Torres: Ran on A10s. Latency p50/p95 with batch=1 at seq=2048 and seq=8192 for throughput tests used batch=4. I'll paste the numbers in the PR.
Elena Cruz: For the quantized note, add: "quantize is a client hint; runtime may ignore on private deployments without quant libs". Also call out streaming: Zephyr-quant currently supports streaming for small-chunk outputs only.
Rae Torres: Good call. Adding sentence and "Private/Dedicated: redeploy agent with quant-libs v0.9+".
Ben Morales: Add a tiny migration snippet for ops: `sudo apt-get install redwood-quant-kernels && systemctl restart redwood-agent` so Dedicated teams know action.
Rae Torres: I'll include that under migration_notes.
docs-bot: docs lint OK for #4890 (:white_check_mark:) — https://ci.redwood/status/4890
Rae Torres: Draft Go snippet (please sanity-check):
```go
// Go SDK select quantized model with fallback
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
model := "nimbus-7b-quant"
resp, err := client.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateRequest{
  Model: model,
  Input: "Summarize: ...",
  MaxTokens: 200,
  Quantize: true,
})
if err != nil {
  resp, _ = client.Generate(context.Background(), redwood.GenerateRequest{Model: "nimbus-7b", Input: "Summarize: ...", MaxTokens: 200})
}
fmt.Println(resp.Text)
```
Elena Cruz: Looks fine. Note in the docs that `Quantize` field is a best-effort hint. Also show a minimal `curl` example for infra teams.
Rae Torres: Adding `curl` example and cost-per-1k-tokens row to the bench table per Ben's ask.
Ben Morales: For the bench table, add a footnote: "throughput measured on A10 x1, batch=4, seq=8192; latency measured batch=1, seq=2048" so numbers are reproducible.
preview-bot: Staging preview deployed for PR #4890 — https://staging.docs.redwood/inference/models/preview/nimbus-zephyr
Rae Torres: Requesting review from @Elena and @Ben. Will merge after preview looks good and ops snippet is double-checked. Thanks. :pray:
Elena Cruz: Reviewing now, will push a tiny wording tweak for the migration section.
Ben Morales: I'll validate the cost calc and kernel command on Dedicated test cluster tomorrow morning.
Rae Torres: Cool — keeping thread open until merge.
